title: Lex-Cybernetica Version 3.0: Consolidated Future-Law Framework for Cybernetic Integration, eSapiens, Future Persons and Synthetic Society
description: Lex-Cybernetica Version 3.0 is the Founder-Frozen publication edition of a proposed future-law framework and legislative guideline for cybernetic integration, eSapiens, future Persons and synthetic society. Version 3.0 contains 20 Parts, 100 Articles and Annexes A–H, including Personhood recognition and interim protection, the five-tier Substrate Integration Index (SII) v1.0, Essential Functions and Material Control, local functional autonomy, provider continuity and insolvency duties, cognitive integrity and Neural Trespass, Genesis and modular parentage, identity and continuity, fork/merge/restoration, civic anti-amplification, cross-border Administrative Anchors, remedies, Taxonomy Escape and evidence/reality/horizon controls. It is not enacted law or legal advice.
